newsitem.title: USA: Sanofi to market Photofrin for new use.
newsitem.headline: Sanofi to market Photofrin for new use.

text.p: Sanofi Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Tuesday it would market QLT PhotoTherapeutics Inc's Photofrin for treatment of lung cancer, when a recently-submitted supplemental NDA was approved.

Sanofi Pharmaceuticals is a unit of France-based Sanofi SA. Sanofi now markets the light-activated drug in the United States, under license from QLT, for the palliative treatment of patients with completely obstructing esophageal cancer.

The supplemental New Drug Application (NDA) was to use Photofrin photodynamic therapy to reduce certain symptoms in patients with obstructing certain endobronchial cell lung cancers, and also to treat endobronchial carcinoma in patients not recommended for surgery or radiotherapy, it said.

Photodynamic therapy is a minimally invasive process in which a photosensitive drug is injected and accumulates mostly in cancer tissue, and is then activated by non-thermal laser light. This produces cytotoxicity to destroy the tumor cells, the company said.
